scope: Static GPU verification of reusable local-UV geometry and materials; production overworld rendering is not replaced and no wind clock is introduced.
fixed_lower_strip: exact full RGBA equality across static bend values
negative_control: Four unclamped shader controls must differ by at least 64/255 in at least 500 pixels, with the same source texture and an explicitly extended UV range.
ownership: Exactly one quad per each of three independent viewports during a case; zero after queue_free.
focus: Recorded truthfully and informational for static GPU targets, consistent with TESTING.md static-data protocols.
exploration: First probe was rejected for assigning canvas_transform before adding its viewport. Second probe compared atlas sampling directly against geometric reflection and exposed a two-byte raster precision delta. The accepted fresh third probe separates strict same-geometry sampling from independent geometric reflection; no failed native files were relabeled or re-signed.
